recall.minute: A unit computes z = w·x + b and y = g(z): worked w = [0.2, 0.3, 0.9], b = 0.5, x = [0.5, 0.6, 0.1] → z = 0.87, σ ≈ 0.705. At z = ±2: sigmoid 0.881/0.119, tanh ±0.964, ReLU 2/0. Sigmoid/tanh saturate (σ′(10) ≈ 0.00005); ReLU can die. Perceptrons do AND (w = [1, 1], b = −1) and OR (b = 0) but not XOR (not linearly separable; Minsky and Papert). A ReLU hidden layer W = [[1,1],[1,1]], b = [0,−1] gives h = (0,0),(1,0),(1,0),(2,1) and output h₁ − 2h₂ = 0,1,1,0. Feedforward layers: a = g(Wa + b); softmax of [0.6, 1.1, −1.5, 1.2, 3.2, −1.1] ≈ [0.055, 0.090, 0.007, 0.100, 0.738, 0.010] (Σe = 33.235). Text: features or embeddings, pad or pool (mean [1,2], max [2,4]; order lost). Neural LM: concatenate embeddings of the previous words, hidden layer, softmax over V; generalises across similar words (cat/dog gets fed). Train with cross-entropy and gradient descent via backprop: (ŷ − y)x = −0.6, w += 0.06 with η = 0.1. LLMs: prompts, zero-/few-shot in-context learning, hallucination. Transfer learning: freeze and add layers or fine-tune; transductive vs inductive.
